independent_method: Raw component and source joins; adaptive integration of cluster gas density and mass-profile derivatives; all forecasts, fits, objective minima, metrics, exclusions, paired host resampling and nonpositive-force retention. No analysis-code imports.
limits: One eta is used across gas phases, but disk constant-weight source scaling and spherical finite-Rc cluster integral are different geometry calculations.
A disk evaluation radius cutoff cannot bound finite-Rc source approximation error: exterior sources contribute. No exact finite-Rc disk reconstruction is present.
The cold-HI versus hot-ICM extension is the tested hypothesis; the published hot-gas-only model is not falsified by its failure.
Cluster zero values in disk-only ggas/gstar columns are unused placeholders; measured cluster gas enters through nonzero source-density quadrature.
Disk-only fits do not identify Rc; cold-to-cluster transfer assumes external fixed Rc=400 kpc.
Frozen CLASH coefficients include CLASH targets from earlier work, so CLASH scores are descriptive. All newly refitted test targets are excluded as declared.
Cluster speed percentages are algebraic square-root transforms, not measured disk orbital-speed errors.
Resampling intervals are descriptive conditional on frozen forecasts and omit calibration/systematic/model-selection uncertainty.
